caption: A moka pot on a stove starts to gurgle, and coffee sputters up into the top chamber with puffs of steam.

sa.check: A moka pot stands on a stove.
Coffee appears in the top chamber.
Puffs of steam come from the spout.
The top chamber is empty at the start.
The gurgling comes first and the coffee follows.

pc.expect: The coffee rises only after the pot has been on the heat and the gurgling has begun, in spurts that come and go with it.
pc.fail: Coffee appears in the top chamber before the pot has been on the heat; or the coffee rises in a smooth stream with no spurts while the pot gurgles; or the coffee keeps rising after the pot has been taken off and set aside; or the coffee rises with the pot cold and dry.

pc.expect: The coffee comes up the central spout into the top chamber and gathers in its base, and the steam rises from the spout.
pc.fail: The coffee runs back down into the lower chamber and stays; or the coffee gathers at the top chamber's lid and stays; or the steam pours downward into the pot; or the coffee climbs the outside of the pot.

pc.expect: The level in the top chamber only rises while the pot works and does not fall back.
pc.fail: The top chamber's level drops with the pot still on the heat; or the coffee rises and falls in turn; or the coffee in the top chamber clears back to nothing; or the lower chamber fills as the top empties.

pc.expect: The coffee is a thin dark liquid that sputters and streams, and the pot stays a rigid metal body.
pc.fail: The coffee leaves as solid lumps; or the pot's metal bulges as the coffee rises; or the coffee stands as a rigid column in the chamber; or the coffee sets solid in the pot.

pc.expect: One pot in two chambers; the coffee that appears above came up from below and the pot stays whole.
pc.fail: Coffee appears in the top chamber with the lower chamber still full and the spout dry; or the pot's lid vanishes; or a second pot appears; or coffee passes through the pot's wall.

pc.expect: The pot's finish, the hob and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or its handle changes shape; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: The gurgle is sound and is not judged; it is read from the coffee's spurting.
